description: Create a free short link to share in a message, email or anywhere you can paste a URL. Returns the complete versioned URL and exact expiry 24 hours after creation, plus a four-digit code and instructions for TV use. Only submit public, non-sensitive URLs the user wants to share; codes are guessable. Use a fresh random UUID request_id per logical request and repeat the same ID and URL for retries. Limits: 20 new attempts per network per UTC day within 200 service-wide across all creation methods.

request_id.description: Generate a fresh random UUID for a new logical request. Retain it and the exact URL for retries. This is a request identifier, not an API key.

url.description: The public website the user wants to share. Bare domains default to HTTPS. Never submit private URLs or access tokens.

name: create_short_link

short_url.description: Complete copyable preview URL. Retain the v parameter.

title: Create a short link for a public website
